# /etc/systemd/system/inventory-database.service
[Unit]
Description=Inventory database service
Documentation=man:systemd.service(5)
After=local-fs.target
Before=inventory-api.service

[Service]
Type=exec
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/rm -f /var/tmp/inventory-database-ready
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-database
ExecStartPost=/bin/sh -c 'i=0; while [ "$i" -lt 100 ]; do [ -e /var/tmp/inventory-database-ready ] && exit 0; i=$((i + 1)); sleep 0.1; done; exit 1'
ExecStopPost=-/usr/bin/rm -f /var/tmp/inventory-database-ready
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=1s
TimeoutStartSec=15s
TimeoutStopSec=15s

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# /etc/systemd/system/inventory-api.service
[Unit]
Description=Inventory API service
Documentation=man:systemd.service(5)
Requires=inventory-database.service
After=inventory-database.service

[Service]
Type=exec
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/test -e /var/tmp/inventory-database-ready
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-api
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=1s
TimeoutStartSec=15s
TimeoutStopSec=15s

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
